invariants.rationale: result is directly created and returned by HoodieListData.lazy, which is expected to return a non-null instance.
HoodieListData.lazy(records) is expected to wrap the list such that the count in result matches the size of the input list.
Method is expected to work with non-null input; likely a precondition, but remains valid at exit.
Since HoodieListData.lazy creates a data structure that delegates to 'records', collecting back into a list should yield the original records list (by equality of contents).
